description: This file implements a cross-platform interface for thread local storage, supporting Windows UWP and POSIX systems. It defines functions to create, destroy, set, and get thread-local storage indices and values, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: CreateTLSIndex
methods.description: Creates a new thread local storage index, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DestroyTLSIndex
methods.description: Destroys a given TLS index, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: SetTLSValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a given TLS index in the current thread.

methods.name: GetTLSValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a TLS index for the current thread.
